n, m, P = map(int, input().split())

f = [0] * (m + 1)
g = [0] * (m + 1)
p = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
q = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
C = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

def upd(x, y):
    x[0] += y
    if x[0] >= P:
        x[0] -= P

f[0] = 1
for i in range(m + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        val1 = (f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % P
        val1 = (val1 * (i + 1)) % P
        val1 = (val1 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        upd([f[i]], val1)

        val2 = (f[j - 1] * g[i - j]) % P
        val2 = (val2 + f[i - j] * g[j - 1]) % P
        val2 = (val2 * (i + 1)) % P
        val2 = (val2 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        upd([g[i]], val2)

        val3 = (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) % P
        val3 = (val3 * f[j - 1]) % P
        val3 = (val3 * f[i - j]) % P
        val3 = (val3 * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        upd([g[i]], val3)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, m) + 1):
        for k in range(0, j + 1):
            val1 = (p[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % P
            val1 = (val1 * C[j][k]) % P
            upd([p[i][j]], val1)

            val2 = (p[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k]) % P
            val2 = (val2 + q[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % P
            val2 = (val2 * C[j][k]) % P
            upd([q[i][j]], val2)
    if i <= m:
        p[i][i] = f[i]
        q[i][i] = g[i]

print(q[n][m])
